item.title: Lab releases small open model
item.description: Example Lab released Tiny-3B, a 3 billion parameter language model, on Tuesday. The model is licensed under Apache 2.0. It scores 71 on the MMLU benchmark and runs on a laptop with 16 GB of memory.

item.title: Regulator opens consultation on model reporting
item.description: The Digital Authority opened a public consultation on Monday about incident reporting for large AI models. Responses are due by 15 December. The proposal would apply to models trained with more than 10^26 operations.

item.title: Chipmaker announces inference accelerator
item.description: Northwind announced the N200 inference accelerator on Wednesday. The company says it delivers twice the throughput of its previous chip at the same power. Shipping is planned for the second quarter of next year.
